title: Prey whose condensed state, not their matter, needs fuel: Cahn-Hilliard prey material drawn up its own fuel-driven catalysis product nucleates bodies from noise that dissolve within ~300 t of a fuel cut (matter kept); c42-style predators introduced at t=2000 convert most prey bodies into predator droplets, then prey re-nucleate, grow and divide as dumbbells beside 17 standing predators to t=12000
summary: world.py: prey material phi_a (c_a=(phi_a+1)/2) is a Cahn-Hilliard field that is miscible (r0=0.3) unless drawn up its own product p (mu_a -= beta p, beta 6), and p is made by catalysis kc F c_a^2 (1-p) on a consumed, regrowing fuel F; no term makes prey matter from fuel. Prey-only (prey_fork.png): ~18 bodies nucleate from smoothed noise by t~2000; setting F=0 and kF=0 at t=3000 dissolves every body by t~3300 while the mean prey material is unchanged. Predators (c42's CH predator, eat = k2 c_a c_b^2, decay kq=0.002 to waste, waste remade into prey material everywhere, closed material ledger) added as noise at t=2000 nucleate on prey bodies and turn 15 of 18 into predator droplets within ~500 t (attack_zoom.png); prey then re-nucleate from the bath and grow, and from t~6000 prey bodies elongate and split as dumbbells (run_b.png, 15 -> 18 bodies) beside 17 static predator droplets that live on dissolved prey. Predators do not divide here, seed 0 only, 128^2, drive.py counts only.
